name: Luminary Health
description: AI clinical decision support platform for radiology, helping radiologists detect and diagnose conditions faster and more accurately.
notes: Strong product-market fit in radiology. Expanding to cardiology imaging in H2 2026.

name: Spectra Analytics
description: Enterprise data intelligence platform that unifies disparate data sources and delivers AI-powered business insights at scale.
notes: Largest portfolio company by headcount. Enterprise pipeline growing well; exploring FedRAMP certification.

name: Vaultik
description: AI-first cybersecurity platform purpose-built for financial services, providing real-time threat detection and compliance automation.
notes: Early stage but strong founding team. First 4 customers are mid-market banks. Pursuing SOC 2 Type II.

name: CodeWeave
description: AI code generation platform designed for enterprise engineering teams, offering context-aware completions and security-first code synthesis.
notes: Co-led Series A with Index Ventures. Strong developer adoption; enterprise upsell motion gaining traction.

name: TerraMind
description: Climate risk modeling platform that uses machine learning to help insurers, governments, and enterprises quantify and manage environmental risk.
notes: Participated in Series A alongside Breakthrough Energy Ventures. Insurance vertical showing strongest PMF; runway getting tight.

name: NovaBio
description: Computational drug discovery platform using AI molecular simulation to accelerate lead compound identification and optimization.
notes: Monitoring — a16z Bio-backed, raising Series A ~$18M. Strong scientific team; need to assess commercial strategy.

name: DataForge
description: Real-time data infrastructure for event-driven architectures, enabling developers to build reactive data pipelines with minimal boilerplate.
notes: Monitoring — referred by LP (Horizon Ventures). Bootstrapped to ~$600K ARR with 4.2K GitHub stars. Strong dev community signals.

name: Bloom AI
description: Generative AI platform for marketing teams, automating content creation across channels while maintaining brand voice and compliance.
notes: 1 meeting held. Remote-first team, EU-based. Raising Series A ~$12M. Need to assess differentiation in crowded GenAI content space.

name: AgriMind
description: Precision agriculture AI that optimizes crop yields through satellite imagery analysis, soil sensors, and predictive climate models.
notes: 2 meetings held. US presence established. Raising Series A ~$15M. Strong LatAm traction; evaluating US market entry strategy.

name: Meridian Cyber
description: Autonomous threat detection and response platform that uses AI to identify, contain, and remediate security incidents in real time.
notes: 1 meeting held. Raising Series B ~$45M. Strong gov/defense traction; evaluating fit with Vaultik portfolio overlap.

name: HealthBridge
description: AI-powered clinical trials matching platform that accelerates patient recruitment by connecting patients to relevant trials based on medical records.
notes: 3 meetings completed, data room shared. Raising Series A ~$14M. Maya running technical DD on NLP pipeline. Synergies with Luminary Health.

name: CloudNest
description: Edge computing platform that optimizes AI inference at the edge, reducing latency and cost for real-time machine learning applications.
notes: Multiple meetings held, tech deep-dive complete. Raising Series A ~$18M. SF office for US go-to-market. Strong technical architecture.

name: Parallel Systems
description: GPU orchestration platform for AI workloads, enabling enterprises to efficiently manage and scale compute resources across cloud and on-premise infrastructure.
notes: Customer references complete. Raising Series A ~$20M. $3.2M ARR, 28 enterprise customers. Strong unit economics and retention.

name: SignalFox
description: Conversational AI platform for enterprise sales teams, automating prospect engagement, qualification, and pipeline management.
notes: Term sheet issued — AIVC leading $14M Series A. 145% NRR, 42 customers, $2.8M ARR. Strong sales motion and product stickiness.

name: Finley
description: AI-powered financial planning platform for SMBs, automating bookkeeping, forecasting, and strategic financial guidance.
notes: Term sheet issued — co-leading with Ribbit Capital $12M Series A. 320 SMB customers, $1.9M ARR. Clean cap table, efficient growth.
